curve.comment: d runs 0..1: cityIndex * cityStep + areaFraction * areaSpan, capped at 1. cityStep * 7 + areaSpan = 1, so the ceiling is the last area of the last city. Stats are not a straight lerp. Knots map d to a 0..1 blend: goal is the parcel target, danger is speed, density and row gap. Global indexes below gentle stay on the floor (the first two areas). By d=0.1 (Bengaluru area 5) the parcel knot has stepped up. After that shoulder, danger's slope increases toward d=1 (ease-in), so late cities get the steep part. A pure power ease-in on raw d would still be flat at area 5, which is the stretch playtests called too easy.

intro.tip: Tap left or right of your rider to change lanes. Grab a parcel, then ride through a green DROP zone.
More autos and cars on the road. Keep your parcels safe.
Potholes and speed breakers slow you right down. Swipe up (or press ⬆) to jump them.
Cows can't be jumped. Change lanes!

weather.rainTip: Rain slows your lane changes. Move early.
weather.nightTip: Night shift. Watch the road closely.
weather.finaleTip: Last stop in the city. Clear it to ride on to the next one.

endless.name: Endless
endless.tip: How far can you go? It never stops getting faster.

tips: Back-to-back deliveries without a crash multiply your coins, up to ×3.
Coins line the open lane. Follow them through traffic.
Each home takes one parcel. Carry up to 3, and a crash knocks one off your box.
Jump early. Potholes arrive fast once you're up to speed.
Finish with all 3 hearts for 3 stars.

threats.comment: Moving threats unlock by global area index (0 = Koramangala). The unlock area teaches one threat alone; the next area is a breather with fewer threats. chance is the share of rows that carry a moving threat, by difficulty.

schedule.tip: New: people crossing. They walk slowly across the road. Time your lane, or go round them.
New: a cow ambling down your lane. It moves slowly, so you catch up fast. Change lanes early to go round it.
New: swerving autos. When an auto flashes its indicator, it is about to cut into the next lane.
New: a street dog gives chase. Keep your speed up: a crash or a pothole lets it catch you. Drop off a parcel and it gives up.
New: wrong-way scooters. They ride straight at you, so they arrive fast.

brake.tip: New: brake. Swipe down and hold (or hold ⬇) to slow down, never stop. Let go to speed back up. Braking resets your combo.

cop.comment: Traffic cop from global index 7 (Bengaluru area 8, JP Nagar). That area places one cop early and keeps the cow tip; the one-time hint is cop.hint, shown in the run the first time he whistles. After that, chance eases in with the level. patrolFrom: he walks to the next lane after stepping in. He only steps into a lane when another lane stays open.
cop.hint: Traffic cop! Switch lanes while he whistles. He stops you and takes a small fine.

powers.comment: Power-ups unlock by global area index. The unlock area always shows the new one early; after that, chance is the share of reward slots that hold a power-up.

schedule.tip: New: magnet. Grab it and coins fly to you from every lane for a few seconds.
New: parcel net. Scoops up parcels from the lanes beside you, and from further ahead.
New: safety helmet. It takes one hit for you, then shatters.
New: nitro. A burst of speed: nothing can hit you, and potholes don't slow you. Great for losing a dog.
New: 2× coins. Every coin and delivery pays double for ten seconds.
New: extra heart. It only shows up when you've lost one.

cityThreats.comment: Each city after Bengaluru brings a signature feature, introduced in its area 3 (at = global index). Puddles and monkeys appear on top of normal traffic, in the open lane just before its reward; zones, hot food and crowds carry on into later cities; fog stays in Delhi and trams in Kolkata.

schedule.tip: New: waterlogged roads. A puddle slows you and makes steering sluggish for a moment. Jump it to stay dry.
New: winter fog. You can only see a short way ahead, so react early.
New: construction zones. Barricades close two lanes for a stretch. Find the open lane and stay in it.
New: parcel thieves. A rival pulls up beside you and lunges for your box. Swipe into them to shove them off, or move a lane away. If they grab one, they drop it up ahead.
New: hot food. Steaming parcels pay a tip if you deliver them within eight seconds.
New: monkeys. One will grab a parcel off your box unless you jump it.
New: tram lines. Trams run toward you down the lane with rails. Keep out of it when one comes.
New: festival crowds. People cross from both sides at once. Wait for your gap.
